title: Punycode Converter
description: Real IDN punycode encode/decode (RFC 3492, implemented locally) — verified against known test vectors.
howto: Type a domain or label (e.g. münchen.de).
Click Encode for punycode, Decode for Unicode.

faqs.a: The RFC 3492 encoding that represents Unicode domain labels in ASCII, e.g. münchen → xn--mnchen-3ya.

faqs.q: How do I know it is correct?
faqs.a: The tool self-tests on load against the known vector "münchen" ↔ "xn--mnchen-3ya" and shows PASS/FAIL.
Yes — each dot-separated label is converted independently; ASCII labels pass through.

faqs.q: Is anything sent to a server?
faqs.a: No — the algorithm is implemented in JavaScript and runs entirely in your browser.
